observations: Three photos show stacks of blue plastic barrels/drums stored under a corrugated roof against a block wall.
Drums appear uniform in size, cylindrical, with a narrow closed top fitted with small screw bungs/caps (visible in photos 1 and 2).
Visible printed text on several drums reads 'GIB OIL' (photo 1, photo 2) - this appears to be the brand of oil that was stored, not a drum manufacturer or model.
Surfaces show staining, dust, and some discoloration consistent with prior use and outdoor/indoor storage.
No visible cracks or holes in the photos, but drums are stacked tightly so most of each drum's surface is hidden from view.
No interior shots are provided; cannot see inside any drum.
A watermark 'SOMTOCHUKWU OCHUMBA' overlays photos 1 and 2, seller/poster identification only.

claims.evidence: Size cannot be measured from photos; drums look like standard industrial barrels, but no scale or measurement shown.
Visible labels in photo 1 and photo 2 read 'GIB OIL', which appears to be a cooking/vegetable oil brand rather than paraffin oil; no paraffin branding is visible anywhere.

claims.claim: Now empty and ready for use
claims.evidence: No interior photo or video showing the inside of any drum; cannot confirm residue-free or empty state.
No water-fill test, pressure test, or close-up of seams/bung threads shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Residual oil or chemical contamination inside drum affecting intended use (e.g., for water storage)
risks.proof: A clear photo or short video looking into the open drum, and/or a smell/wipe test clip showing clean interior

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, dents, warping) hidden by stacking
risks.proof: Individual photos of each drum's full body, especially base and sides, taken separately
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, lowest condition tier

risks.risk: Leak-proof claim unverified, could leak at bung or seams
risks.proof: A video of the drum filled with water and left standing to show no leakage

risks.risk: Missing or stripped bung/cap threads affecting sealing
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bung/cap area showing threads intact

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch - unclear how many drums are actually for sale vs. just shown in storage
risks.proof: Seller confirmation with a count and a photo showing the drums tagged/set aside for this specific sale
risks.if_unproven: priced per single unit only, not bulk lot

proof_requests: Video of drum interior, fully open, showing no residue or paraffin/oil smell
Water-fill leak test video for at least one representative drum
Close-up photos of bung/cap threads and any visible cracks or repairs
Confirmation of exact number of drums included in this listing's price
A photo with a tape measure or known-size object next to a drum to confirm 200L capacity
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used plastic 200L drum; despite unverified cleanliness and leak-proof claims and a contradicted 'paraffin oil' origin claim, it can still be priced at worst case (unclean, unverified leak integrity) pending further proof.
